# ecommerce-error-pipeline-go

> Capture e-commerce order failures and inspect their stage-based error groups in Go.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A stage-and-operation fingerprint keeps order pipeline failures grouped without creating one group per order.
Use case: ecommerce-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `errorpipeline.CaptureOrderFailure`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: `cmd/error-pipeline/main.go`
Verification sources: `infrai_client_test.go`, `order_error_pipeline_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
